ائتلقوا (form VIII)
# اِئْتَلَقُوا (iʔtalaqū) /iʔ.ta.la.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
# اِئْتَلِقُوا (iʔtaliqū) /iʔ.ta.li.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
